answer_1.quote: Our method aims to create customized LLMs that adopt the idiolect of the target writer while retaining the ability to understand and follow natural language instructions... We ask the model to generate a continuation of 256 tokens for each input prompt.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text continuations (256 tokens) in the target author's style

answer_2.quote: We evaluate ... across three dimensions: perplexity on withheld text, style-embedding alignment, and linguistic alignment. Perplexity ... Style-embedding Alignment ... Lexical and Surface are measured by MSE, while Syntactic is measured by JSD.
